title: Chovisi of Rishabhnath
brief_description: Stone sculpture depicting Chovisi of Rishabhnath acquired from Soncoale, Mormugao Taluka, Goa.
detailed_description: This sculpture represents Rishabhnath, the first Tirthankara of Jainism, accompanied by the Chovisi, a traditional depiction of the twenty-four Jain Tirthankaras. Such sculptures symbolize spiritual liberation, non-violence, and the teachings of Jain philosophy. Acquired from Soncoale in Mormugao Taluka, Goa, this 13th Century C.E. artifact highlights the historical presence of Jainism in Goa and reflects the refined sculptural traditions of medieval western India.
